Elections & Voting

The Elections Division is responsible for the supervision and certification of all elections that take place within the county. The division accepts filings for office and petitions for recall, prepares and prints ballots, programs voting equipment, provides training to election officials and coordinates the certification of each election. The division also accepts campaign finance filings for county and local offices. Additionally, the division maintains permanent records of the Board of Commissioners' resolutions and minutes.
